chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: Tape 8, October 13, 1981: why McRae left Cab
summary: A new session opens and Welburn asks about leaving Cab Calloway; McRae didn't want to go back to California or do studio work.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: This is an interview with Teddy McRae, Tape No. 8. Today's date is Tuesday, October 13, 1981.
And, Teddy, we're back with your career. You had gone with Cab Calloway, and you were with Cab for about one or two years?
You replaced Chu Berry who had died in an auto accident. Now, just finishing the time you were with Cab Calloway, what were the circumstances leading to your leaving Cab's band?
Well, I had been to California a long time (inaudible), you know, with Ella band, (inaudible) Chick Webb's band.
And I felt that I didn't want to go back to California. I had some appointments in New York -- commitments that I had promised when I come back to New York.
In fact, I was supposed to go in NBC. They kept writing, and (inaudible) I wanted to come in.
